items.distractor_fact: Tokiko irrati batek {D}°C jakinarazi zituen goiz hartan.
items.gloss_en: A local radio station reported {D}°C that same morning. (°C sits directly after the number, no suffix changes with size.)
items.entity_note: a local radio station's weather report, an organisation, not the nearby village's thermometer (a place) that the first distractor used

items.distractor_fact: Merkatuko beste indize batek ${D}-ko balioa zuen egun berean.
items.gloss_en: Another market index had a value of ${D} that same day. ("-ko" genitive attaches invariantly after the digit string.)
items.entity_note: a market index, a benchmark instrument, not another company (an organisation) as the first distractor used

items.distractor_fact: Beste ur-konpainia batek {D}m-ko biltegi-maila zuen hilabete berean.
items.gloss_en: Another water company had a storage level of {D}m that same month.
items.entity_note: a different water company's own storage tank, an organisation, not another reservoir (a place) as the first distractor used

items.distractor_fact: Babes Zibileko unitate batek erabilitako aparailuak {D}m-ko altuera izan zuen proba berean.
items.gloss_en: Equipment used by a Civil Protection unit reached an altitude of {D}m in the same trial.
items.entity_note: equipment belonging to a Civil Protection unit, an organisation, not another drone (an instrument) as the first distractor used; avoids reusing the noun "drone"

items.distractor_fact: Beste banaketa-enpresa batek {D}kg-ko zama garraiatu zuen egun berean.
items.gloss_en: Another delivery company transported a load of {D}kg that same day.
items.entity_note: a different delivery company's shipment, an organisation, not another package (an object) as the first distractor used

items.distractor_fact: Antolatzaileek erabilitako erreferentzia-ibilgailu batek {D}km/h-ko abiadura izan zuen proba berean.
items.gloss_en: A reference vehicle used by the organizers reached a speed of {D}km/h in the same trial.
items.entity_note: the organizers' own reference vehicle, an organisation's equipment, not another engine (an instrument) as the first distractor used; avoids reusing the noun "motor"

items.gloss_en: In last year's tournament, the ranking leader scored {D}pts.
items.entity_note: a different tournament's ranking leader, a different series/edition, not another player in the same session (a person) as the first distractor used

items.distractor_fact: Bankuak beste sukurtsal batean ${D}-ko funts orokorra zuen hilabete berean.
items.gloss_en: The bank had a general fund of ${D} at a different branch that same month.
items.entity_note: a different bank branch, a place, not another client's account (a person) as the first distractor used

items.distractor_fact: Beste kide-elkarte batek {D}pts zituen erreserban urte berean.
items.gloss_en: Another members' association had {D}pts in reserve that same year.
items.entity_note: a different members' association, an organisation, not another club member (a person) as the first distractor used

items.distractor_fact: Kontsultari batek bere kontuan ${D} irabazi zituen hilabete berean.
items.gloss_en: A consultant earned ${D} in their own account that same month.
items.entity_note: an unrelated individual consultant, a person, not another shop (an organisation) as the first distractor used

items.distractor_fact: Denboraldi horretako golegile nagusiak {D} gol sartu zituen bere kabuz.
items.gloss_en: That season's top scorer scored {D} goals on their own.
items.entity_note: an individual top scorer, a person, not another team (an organisation) as the first distractor used

items.distractor_fact: Konpainia bereko autobus-zerbitzu batek {D}min-eko atzerapena izan zuen egun berean, bere ordutegi propioaren arabera.
items.gloss_en: A bus service run by the same company had a delay of {D}min that same day, according to its own separate schedule.
items.entity_note: a bus service with its own unstated schedule, a different transport mode/instrument, not another train on a different line (a series) as the first distractor used
